articles.title: Speculation on dogecoin is back to October 2025 levels. The price is down 70%
articles.description: Futures positioning has rebuilt to levels last seen when dogecoin traded at three times today's price, and more than three accounts are betting on a rebound for every one betting against.

articles.title: Bitcoin slips near $63,500 as traders look past CPI to Fed’s next tests
articles.description: An in-line inflation print removed a tail risk but gave BTC little reason to rally, leaving Jackson Hole, jobs data and the next CPI release as the market’s next catalysts.

articles.title: Prediction markets should dial back faulty filings for incentives to boost trading: CFTC
articles.description: The U.S. regulator of platforms such as Kalshi and Polymarket suggests the industry is getting into bad compliance habits that may allow for market abuse.

articles.title: Securitize falls 20% after earnings miss as tokenization revenue falls short
articles.description: Tokenized assets hit a record and trading activity jumped, but revenue slipped in the firm’s first earnings report since going public.

articles.title: Morgan Stanley's infrastructure partner Zerohash rebuffed in pitch to be U.S. trust bank
articles.description: Zerohash, which handles crypto plumbing for Morgan Stanley's E*Trade, said it's planning on re-filing and hoping for a swift resolution.

articles.title: Goldman Sachs leaps into bitcoin income ETFs with $2.25 billion NEOS buyout
articles.description: The $2.25 billion deal expands Goldman’s derivative platform to $130 billion in total ETF assets, taking direct aim at BlackRock's rival BITA fund, according to an analyst.

articles.title: Wintermute plans $1 billion AI push beyond crypto: Bloomberg
articles.description: The firm aims for non-crypto markets to drive over 50% of revenue by 2027, up from 10% currently, as it seeks to diversify its business.

articles.title: Kalshi taps DoubleZero for Wall Street-style high-speed data feed
articles.description: Kalshi is looking to meet institutional demands by adding DoubleZero data to its order book.

articles.title: Miden bets on privacy stablecoins with introduction of USDCx
articles.description: USDCx will let users transact without publicly exposing balances, counterparties or transaction histories, while allowing selective disclosure for compliance.

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: When capital can't move fast enough, markets pay the price
articles.description: In this week's Crypto Long & Short, LMAX Group's Jenna Wright argues that markets break down not from too little capital but from capital stuck in the wrong place, trapped by settlement cycles while risk reprices by the minute. She makes the case that stablecoins and tokenization are quietly becoming the plumbing that lets money move as fast as the risk it supports.

articles.title: Solana neared a freeze threshold Wednesday, Marinade Finance says. The Foundation says it held up under stress.
articles.description: A routing glitch at a major data center provider knocked nearly 29% of Solana’s staked tokens offline, bringing the network within striking distance of a full freeze, while Foundation executives stressed that blocks and transactions never stopped.

articles.title: Standard Chartered-led Anchorpoint launches Hong Kong dollar stablecoin
articles.description: HashKey Exchange and OSL Group are now authorized distributors, enabling institutional and professional investors to mint and redeem HKDAP tokens.

articles.title: America doesn’t need a second-class payments system
articles.description: If an institution qualifies to participate in America’s banking system, it should have a clear path to America’s payment system, argues Anchorage Digital's Rachel Anderika.

articles.title: U.S. CPI inflation slows to 3.4% as expected, bitcoin holds near $64,000
articles.description: Both headline and core inflation matched economists’ expectations, while bitcoin held near $64,000 and Treasury yields declined.

articles.title: FlightAware drops Kalshi lawsuit over a market niche that data shows it never took off
articles.description: The flight-tracking company voluntarily dismissed, without prejudice and without sharing a motive for its decision. However, the flight cancellation market never took off with Kalshi users.

articles.title: Russia moves to restrict retail crypto trading to bitcoin, ether and USDT
articles.description: Non-qualified investors face a 300,000-ruble (approx. $3,600) annual purchase limit per intermediary, while qualified investors have no cap.

articles.title: XRP trading could get spicy after CPI report as futures bets hit highest since October
articles.description: Your day-ahead look for Aug. 12, 2026

articles.title: Bitcoin holds near $64,000 as U.S. inflation data looms, Harmony exploit rattles altcoins
articles.description: Markets are quiet ahead of the July inflation print, with bitcoin little changed, oil near $90 and Harmony nursing a fresh exploit.

articles.title: Bank of England to test stablecoin, digital currency use in cross-border finance
articles.description: The BOE-led Digital Pound Lab will test trade-finance interoperability, in which exporters receive stablecoins while importers settle in a potential digital pound.

articles.title: CoreWeave surges 16% on $2.58 billion revenue quarter as AI infrastructure demand eclipses crypto
articles.description: Booming AI demand sends CRWV up 16% and lifts IREN and CIFR as investors favor computing infrastructure over crypto.

articles.title: Fidelity moves to add staking, quarterly payouts to near $900 million ether ETF
articles.description: The fund would keep 85% of gross staking rewards, with the remaining 15% going to service providers.

articles.title: One overlooked group has added $1.78 billion of selling pressure to bitcoin market
articles.description: Public miners are an underappreciated source of supply hitting the market right at the margin.

articles.title: Live updates: AI stocks surge on Q2 beats, bitcoin falls below $64,000 as inflation hits estimates
articles.description: Blockchain data shows the Japanese treasury firm moved the bitcoin between wallets it controls, not to an exchange, so the transfer isn't a sale despite its $1.4 billion paper loss.

articles.title: Crypto.com rolls out tokenized stock derivatives as crypto exchanges push into equities
articles.description: The exchange is joining a tokenized stock market that has grown 600% in a year, though its products offer price exposure rather than share ownership.

articles.title: Here's what bitcoin and ether traders are doing ahead of the binary U.S. CPI print
articles.description: Bitcoin and ether are stuck in a tight range ahead of the CPI. Here’s how savvy traders are positioning for the pivotal release.
